newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices ease further in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices ease further in week.

text.p: Australian wool prices eased further at sales this week in Newcastle, Adelaide and Fremantle, the Australian Council of Wool Exporters said.
The eastern market indicator fell four cents to 566 cents a kg clean, while the western market indicator fell five cents to 527 cents a kg.
A total of 108,298 bales were offered, with a pass-in rate of 11.9 percent.
"Given the quantity on offer and the continuing subdued demand situation, prices held up as well as could have been expected," the council said.
Westfarmers Dalgety Ltd said this week's market was relatively firm, considering the offering was the largest for the season.

Wool International said it sold 11,760 bales in the week ended Thursday and its stockpile now stands at 2,018,868 bales. In the futures market, a total of 151 contracts were traded in the 21 micron contract in the week ended November 14.
Open interest decreased by 31 contracts to close at 845.
Sales next week are in Goulburn, Melbourne and Fremantle with a total of about 103,000 bales on offer.
